page.overview:
Who is Draiven Bosh?

Draiven Bosh was a Moldwarp thief and collector who lived during the High Republic Era. He owned a droid named K-2PL and an astromech droid named R4-13.

Draiven Bosh was created for the animated series Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures, and is voiced by Kyle MacLachlan.
